title: AGL and TRUenergy - proposed swap of South Australian electricity assets

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed transaction.

body_sections.Summary: AGL Energy and TRUenergy proposed to enter into an agreement whereby TRUenergy would transfer its gas fired 1280MW Torrens Island electricity generation facility, and associated gas supply contracts and facilities, to AGL, and AGL would transfer its 180MW gas fired electricity generator at Hallet to TRUenergy.
